    Class Description
    com.datastax.driver.core.JdkSSLOptions

    com.datastax.driver.core.NettySSLOptions

    com.datastax.driver.core.policies.DowngradingConsistencyRetryPolicy
    as of version 3.5.0, this retry policy has been deprecated, and it will be removed in 4.0.0. See our upgrade guide to understand how to migrate existing applications that rely on this policy.
    com.datastax.driver.core.policies.IdempotenceAwareRetryPolicy
    As of version 3.1.0, the driver doesn't retry non-idempotent statements for write timeouts or unexpected errors anymore. It is no longer necessary to wrap your retry policies in this policy.

    com.datastax.driver.core.ExtendedAuthProvider.newAuthenticator​(InetSocketAddress, String)
    the driver will never call this method on ExtendedAuthProvider instances. Implementors should throw AssertionError.
    com.datastax.driver.core.Host.getAddress()
    This is exposed mainly for historical reasons. Internally, the driver uses Host.getEndPoint() to establish connections. This is a shortcut for getEndPoint().resolve().getAddress().
    com.datastax.driver.core.Host.getDseVersion()
    Please use the Java Driver for DSE if you are connecting to a DataStax Enterprise (DSE) cluster. This method might not function properly with future versions of DSE.
    com.datastax.driver.core.Host.getDseWorkload()
    Please use the Java Driver for DSE if you are connecting to a DataStax Enterprise (DSE) cluster. This method might not function properly with future versions of DSE.
    com.datastax.driver.core.Host.getSocketAddress()
    This is exposed mainly for historical reasons. Internally, the driver uses Host.getEndPoint() to establish connections. This is a shortcut for getEndPoint().resolve().
    com.datastax.driver.core.Host.isDseGraphEnabled()
    Please use the Java Driver for DSE if you are connecting to a DataStax Enterprise (DSE) cluster. This method might not function properly with future versions of DSE.
    com.datastax.driver.core.Host.setLwtInfo​(LwtInfo)
    lwtInfo should not be manipulated.
    com.datastax.driver.core.Host.setShardingInfo​(ShardingInfo)

    com.datastax.driver.core.Metadata.getReplicas​(String, String, Token.Factory, ByteBuffer)
    use Metadata.getReplicasList(String, String, Token.Factory, ByteBuffer)
    com.datastax.driver.core.policies.DCAwareRoundRobinPolicy.Builder.allowRemoteDCsForLocalConsistencyLevel()
    This functionality will be removed in the next major release of the driver. DC failover shouldn't be done in the driver, which does not have the necessary context to know what makes sense considering application semantics.
    com.datastax.driver.core.policies.DCAwareRoundRobinPolicy.Builder.withUsedHostsPerRemoteDc​(int)
    This functionality will be removed in the next major release of the driver. DC failover shouldn't be done in the driver, which does not have the necessary context to know what makes sense considering application semantics.
    com.datastax.driver.core.policies.RackAwareRoundRobinPolicy.Builder.allowRemoteDCsForLocalConsistencyLevel()
    This functionality will be removed in the next major release of the driver. DC failover shouldn't be done in the driver, which does not have the necessary context to know what makes sense considering application semantics.
    com.datastax.driver.core.policies.RackAwareRoundRobinPolicy.Builder.withUsedHostsPerRemoteDc​(int)
    This functionality will be removed in the next major release of the driver. DC failover shouldn't be done in the driver, which does not have the necessary context to know what makes sense considering application semantics.
    com.datastax.driver.core.querybuilder.BuiltStatement.escapeId​(String)
    preserved for backward compatibility, use Metadata.quoteIfNecessary(String) instead.
    com.datastax.driver.core.SSLOptions.newSSLHandler​(SocketChannel)
